boundary_evidence: ONE FUNCTION, THREE SECTIONS. 0x02073534..0x0207359c is a single MSL C++ runtime partial-array-destroy helper whose out-of-line catch landing pad the symbol table had split off as func_02073584. The cartridge's own .exceptix record at 0x020739b8 declares the function length as 0x68 = 0x50 + 0x18, which is the direct evidence that the two ranges are one function and one translation unit.

THE UNWIND RECORDS ARE THIS TU'S OUTPUT. Compiled with tools/rombuild.py's exact command (2004/b56, CFLAGS carrying -Cpp_exceptions off, -lang c++ because of the //cpp marker), the in-file `#pragma exceptions on` wins and the object carries .text 104, .exception 20 and .exceptix 12. All three reproduce the cartridge byte for byte outside relocation slots, with no padding of any kind, and every slot resolves to the symbol config/arm9/relocs.txt records.
NOT FROM tools/tu_map.py. The arm9 main module is reported under-segmented and emits one unit for 0x20049f0..0x20707a4; this entry was assembled by hand from the .exceptix length field.

exception.evidence: compiler-emitted exception frame record for this function's single try; STB_LOCAL STT_OBJECT at offset 0 of the object's only .exception section, and the 20 bytes are identical to the cartridge with no relocation slots at all

exceptix.evidence: compiler-emitted unwind index entry: function pointer, length 0x68, frame pointer. The middle word is the literal 0x00000068 on both sides, which is the cartridge declaring this function's length; the two pointer words are relocation slots and both resolve

notes: PRODUCTION MODE IS DELIBERATELY ABSENT, and that is the honest state of this entry. tools/rombuild.py intact_tu_policies admits an intact-object TU only on a scratch-data-verified ordinary link that proves every claimed range, all modules and the full ROM. That proof cannot be produced anywhere the dsd delink step aborts, which is every worktree tried so far ('function Div could not be analyzed: IllegalIns { address: 200407e, ins: Thumb(Ins { code: ede6, op: BlxI }) }'). Requesting the intact-object path without it is a hard BuildError, so this entry records the measured shape and does not request the path. config/arm9/delinks.txt therefore claims only the .text range, which is exactly what the build produces.

WHAT THE BUILD DOES TODAY. src/func_02073534.cpp is enrolled as an ordinary single-function source, so tools/objisolate.py takes the one selected symbol and drops the two unwind sections to size 0. The cartridge's copies of those 32 bytes come from the dsd gap objects, as they did before this file existed. Nothing in this entry changes a ROM byte.
This is the third entry in the manifest to claim any of arm9's 636 bytes of retail .exceptix, after arm9/__cxa_vec_cleanup and arm9/func_02073300.
